topic: Types and stages of estimates: preliminary, plinth area, detailed, revised, supplementary

questions.q: 7. *For electric wiring such as fan, light, plug etc, the estimate is made in terms of
options: total load at main in kw
total length of wiring in meters
questions.explain: While individual points are counted, the overall estimate for the system often considers the total load in kilowatts for capacity planning.

questions.q: 38. Estimate is
questions.explain: The fundamental purpose of an estimate is to calculate the probable cost of a project.

questions.q: 39. *The main objective of the estimating is
options: to find the probable cost of the work
to find the quantity of various materials and labour
questions.explain: Estimating aims to determine the likely expenditure required before the project begins.

questions.q: 40. Estimate is
options: the actual cost of construction of a structure
the probable cost arrived at before commencement of the structure
questions.explain: An estimate is a forecast of cost, whereas 'actual cost' is only known after completion.

questions.q: 41. *Which of the following is the most correct estimate?
questions.explain: A detailed estimate is the most accurate as it involves item-by-item quantity calculations.

questions.q: 42. Estimate expected to be least accurate is
questions.explain: Plinth area estimates are preliminary/approximate and based on rough rates per unit area.

questions.q: 43. *The plinth area estimate method is also known as
questions.explain: Because it uses the floor area (measured in square meters/feet) to calculate cost, it is also called the square rate method.

questions.q: 44. Plinth area estimate is a approximate estimate mostly used for the estimation of
questions.explain: Plinth area (floor area) is a concept specific to buildings.

questions.q: 46. *Actual cost of the structure is obtained
questions.explain: Actual cost represents the final total spent, which is only certain once the project is finished.

questions.q: 47. The actual cost of supplementary and revised estimate is
questions.explain: The final actual cost is only realized upon completion of the works defined in the estimates.

questions.q: 48. Which one estimate is the best among all?
questions.explain: A detailed estimate provides the most comprehensive and reliable cost breakdown.

questions.q: 61. *Of the total estimated cost a building, the cost of electrification usually accounts
questions.explain: Electrical installations are generally estimated as 8% of the total building cost.

questions.q: 67. In the detailed estimate the areas are worked out to the nearest
questions.explain: Standard practice in quantity surveying is to record areas to two decimal places (0.01 m^2).

questions.q: 68. In the detailed estimate the volumes are worked out to the nearest
questions.explain: Volumes are calculated with higher precision, usually to three decimal places (0.01 m^3).

questions.q: 71. Which is considered in the calculation of plinth area?
questions.explain: Plinth area includes the wall thickness and internal circulation spaces like corridors.

questions.q: 72. Which is not considered in the calculation of plinth area?
questions.explain: Uncovered projections or cantilevered beams outside the wall line are excluded from the plinth area.

questions.q: 74. The plan of a building is in the from of a rectangle with centerline dimension of outer walls as 9.7m x 14.7m. The thickness of the wall in super structure is 0.30m. Then its plinth area is
75. *In the case of unsewered areas, an additional provision for septic tank is usually
questions.explain: Standard estimates add 3-4% for sanitary and water supply works including septic tanks.

questions.q: 93. *The plan of a building is in the form of rectangle with center line dimension of outer walls as 9.7m x 14.7m. The thickness of the wall in super structure is 0.30m. Then its carpet area is
questions.explain: Carpet area = Inner dimensions. (9.7-0.3) x (14.7-0.3) = 9.4 x 14.4 = 135.36 m^2.

questions.q: 98. For the approval of any project a no. of sanction is followed out. Which one is initially done?
questions.explain: Administrative sanction is the formal acceptance of the project proposal by the department before technical details are finalized.

questions.q: 167. Tentative cost of a road project is calculated by
questions.explain: Preliminary or tentative estimates for roads are usually prepared on a 'per kilometer' or 'per meter' length basis.

questions.q: 170. The appropriate cost to the complete labour as a percentage of the total cost of the building is
questions.explain: On average, labor costs account for approximately 25% to 30% of the total construction cost of a building.

questions.q: 171. The covered area of a proposed building is 150 m2 and it includes a rear courtyard of 5m x 4m. If the prevailing plinth area rate for similar building is Rs.1250 / m2, what is its cost?
questions.explain: Courtyards are excluded from plinth area. Plinth Area = 150 - (5x4) = 130 m2. Cost = 130 * 1250 = Rs. 1,62,500.

questions.q: 172. At present the cost of Residential building per square feet in Kathmandu
questions.explain: Based on the provided book context (likely older data), the rate is 1500-2000. Current 2026 market rates are higher, but we follow the provided key.

questions.q: 173. Demolition means
options: breaking up the structure with care
questions.explain: Demolition refers to the systematic destruction of a building where the recovery of materials is not the primary concern.

questions.q: 174. Dismental means
options: breaking up the structure with care
questions.explain: Dismantling implies taking a structure apart carefully so that the components can be salvaged and reused.

questions.q: 175. The useful part of liveable area of a building is also known as
questions.explain: Carpet area is the actual usable area within the walls of a room where a carpet can be spread.

questions.q: 176. Which one area must be greater at any floor of a building?
questions.explain: Plinth area is the largest as it includes the floor area plus the area occupied by the walls.

questions.q: 179. A document containing detailed description of all the types of work together with their current rates is called
questions.explain: The Schedule of Rates (SOR) is a standard document issued by departments listing current market rates for various construction items.

questions.q: 182. The investment required for the completion of any project is obtained by
questions.explain: Estimating provides the probable cost, which informs the investment or budget needed before the project starts.

questions.q: 185. The expenses of items which do not come under any regular head of items and the cost of unforeseen items are called
questions.explain: Contingencies represent a percentage (usually 3-5%) of the estimate set aside for incidental or unexpected expenses.

questions.q: 186. Which one is correct with respect to floor area and plinth area?
options: floor area is always greater than plinth area
floor area is always equal to plinth area
floor area is always lesser than plinth area
questions.explain: Floor area is the plinth area minus the area occupied by the walls, hence it is always smaller.

questions.q: 224. Which of the following factors is a reason for the need to provide for contingency in the cost estimate of a project?
questions.explain: Contingencies are funds set aside for unforeseen expenses or uncertainties during the project execution.

questions.q: 226. Which of the following can not be considered as engineering estimate
questions.explain: An eye estimate is based on intuition rather than detailed engineering calculations or measurements.
